customData.page_goal: Get Boise homeowners to ask for an on-site tree removal quote by phone or through the form.
customData.site_description: Lead-generation site for tree removal in Boise. Calls and quote requests go to the local tree crew that rents the site. Most callers want a dead or leaning tree taken out of a back yard.
customData.areas_served:
North End
Boise Bench
Southeast Boise
West Boise
customData.keywords:
tree removal Boise
Boise tree removal service
dead tree removal Boise
stump grinding Boise
customData.included_services:
Removal of whole trees in back and front yards
Taking a tree down in sections by climbing when there is no room to fell it
Hauling away branches and trunk wood
Stump grinding, quoted separately as an add-on
customData.excluded_services:
Trimming or pruning trees that stay
Any tree in contact with power lines
Firewood splitting
customData.business_facts:
Quotes are free and given after the crew looks at the tree in person
Branches and trunk wood are hauled away unless the homeowner asks to keep the wood
Calls and quote forms are answered on business days
customData.local_notes:
Many back yards are fenced, with gates narrower than a truck
When the gate is too narrow for equipment, the crew carries branches and wood out by hand
customData.cta: Call or send the quote form to book a free on-site quote
